svg.title: Correlation without cointegration
svg.desc: Correlation without cointegration. A = X + 0.2Y; B = X | X and Y: independent random walks. First-difference correlation: population 0.980581, sample 0.979765. Nonstationary spread: A - B = 0.2Y. Var(dX) = Var(dY) = 1. Var(A - B) = 0.04t; no fixed hedge removes Y. Synthetic observations, not market prices; stationarity follows from construction, not visual inspection.
